integrity: Proof is analytic with finite numerical consistency checks. The general stationary inverse-hazard and jump-flux covariance identities are expressly prior work, not newly claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional centered OU target compression, source width strictly below target, unbounded spatial hazard, exact stationary law, high mean reset flux; jump-channel entropy only, not physical reset work. Competing independent/implicit prior formulations remain possible.
title: A Gaussian source-width transition in adaptive-resetting jump entropy production
